description: List the secret files on an issue or a wiki page that this token's person reads — the title its author gave it, the size, who reads it, who is waiting for a key, and whether the key is due a change. Never the contents or the file's own name: they are encrypted on the readers' devices and this server cannot open them, so neither can you through it. Pass issueKey or pageId.
name: list_secret_files
title: List secret files
